subject: Q1 Capacity True-up and one-time settlement — proposed plan
messages:
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@lighthouse.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Lighthouse Analytics Billing <billing@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q1 unexpected capacity — reconciliation request

Hi Sofia,

We ran a post-quarter audit and discovered roughly 22% more inference usage than our committed capacity for Q1 (April–June). Our billing team flagged a one-time delta of ~USD 14,200 that we want to reconcile. I attached our internal usage export for your reference (usage-report-q1.csv).

Can you confirm how Redwood calculates retroactive usage in these cases? We're trying to avoid a surprise invoice but acknowledge the consumption — looking for options: one-time charge, credit offset, or modest term amendment.

Would prefer a short call if needed — available Wed/Thu morning PT.

Thanks,
Alex Ruiz
Head of Platform Ops
Lighthouse Analytics
Attachment: usage-report-q1.csv (CSV, 78 KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 unexpected capacity — reconciliation request

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for sending the usage export. We pulled your side-by-side with our usage logs and see the same ~22% delta.

Short answer: we typically do a true-up for the quarter with an itemized one-time invoice, but we have three common paths for customers in your situation:
- One-time settlement for the exact overage (standard invoice)
- Partial credit + invoice for remainder (we sometimes grant a goodwill percentage for first-time, low-likelihood events)
- Term amendment to increase committed capacity going forward with a prorated charge and crediting part of the historical overage into the new commitment

I've looped in Ben (Account) and Marissa (Finance) to align on what we can offer for Lighthouse. Ben — can you run a quick commercial sanity check? Marissa — I'll need a draft invoice and the maximum goodwill credit we can approve without exec sign-off.

If it helps, I can propose a settlement: 40% credit on the overage and an amended commitment of +15% capacity for the next 12 months (prorated start) to avoid recurrence. If acceptable, we can send an invoice showing credit and the amendment and include a DocuSign for the term change. I attached a draft invoice proposal for format only.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
Attachment: invoice-proposal-20260614.pdf (PDF, 32 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 unexpected capacity — reconciliation request

Alex / Sofia — quick note from the commercial side. We reviewed Lighthouse's rate card and current commit. Programmatically, rewarding a 40% credit for a single-quarter overage is borderline but within our playbook for long-term customers with steady growth signals.

Proposal (commercial):
- One-time invoice for the net overage after a 35% goodwill credit (so Lighthouse pays 65% of the USD 14,200 -> USD 9,230).
- Amend the yearly commitment: +15% capacity starting 2026-07-01, 12-month term. Pricing keeps current tier rates.
- If Lighthouse signs the amendment within 7 days, we'll expedite a 10% rebate applied to the first monthly invoice post-amendment.

Marissa — can finance generate an interim invoice and note the rebate if signed in the window? If we need exec approval for a deeper concession I'll flag tomorning.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 650-555-0210

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 unexpected capacity — reconciliation request

Thanks team — Finance ran the numbers and can support Ben's plan with the following specifics:
1) Invoice: USD 9,230 net (after 35% credit) for the Q1 overage. Invoice will include line items: overage usage, applied credit, and reference to deal DL-2026-1198.
2) Amendment: We'll prepare a short-form amendment that increases committed throughput by 15% for 12 months, effective 2026-07-01.
3) Rebate: 10% credit on the first post-amendment invoice if the amendment is executed within 7 calendar days.

Alex — I've attached the interim invoice PDF and will generate a DocuSign amendment. Please confirm you want the 35% credit and the +15% commitment. Once you confirm, I'll send the DocuSign and the invoice as a single package for easier bookkeeping.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: invoice-proposal-20260614.pdf (updated, PDF, 38 KB)

From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@lighthouse.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 unexpected capacity — reconciliation request

Marissa / Ben / Sofia — thanks, we appreciate the flexibility and the clear path. Lighthouse accepts the 35% credit and will sign the amendment to add +15% commitment. Please send the DocuSign and the interim invoice to billing@lighthouse.ai and cc me. We'll process the net USD 9,230 payment upon receipt of the signed amendment.

Two quick asks:
- Can you include a short notes section on the invoice that references the quarter (Q1 2026) and the usage date range? Our procurement team needs that for internal GL mapping.
- Please confirm the effective date of the increased commitment is 2026-07-01 (as noted).

Once we have the DocuSign link I'll route to our procurement hub — expect sign within 48 business hours. Appreciated.

Best,
Alex Ruiz
Head of Platform Ops
Lighthouse Analytics
